edits.where: 1 box b3.inside (自己评自己), says_zh, first sentence
edits.old: 规则偏向的一方，既定规则，也定怎么评这条规则。
edits.new: 规则由它偏向的一方来定，怎么评这条规则，也由这一方来定。
edits.why: [keep] Says what the English says (the favoured side sets both the rule and how it is judged; ClosedCapture's rule and its reading both formed from the share). 既定规则 was a real trap. The wording matches path lock step 6 (也由同一方来定).

edits.where: 2 arrow a2.ended → a2.supplied (尽了 → 够用), tag_zh
edits.old: 需要放松了，或者外面有补给
edits.new: 需要变小了，或者外面有补给
edits.why: [keep] Glossary form for 'a need loosens'; both alternatives kept. I tried adding a quantifier (有哪样需要变小了) and dropped it: any noun in front of 需要 brings the verb reading back ('something needs to get smaller'). The same tag is proposed again as zh_paths 7 with the same text; it needs one final.

edits.where: 3 arrow a2.ended → a2.supplied, zh
edits.old: 只有还在延续的才给得出、延续又要每样需要都满足的地方：一群里一旦哪个都不够用，只要需要不放松、群外也没有往它们要用的东西里补，就再没有哪个够用。
edits.new: 要是只有还在延续的才给得出，延续又要每样需要都满足：一群里一旦哪个都不够用，只要它们的需要一样都没有变小、群外也没有往它们要用的东西里补，就再没有哪个够用。
edits.why: [fix] The 要是……： opening and both conditions are right, but 没有哪样需要变小 reads first as 'nothing needs to get smaller' (需要 as the verb again, the trap this edit was meant to remove). 它们的需要一样都没有变小 keeps 需要 a noun and keeps the quantifier: Admission.unsupported_stays asks that no requirement of any member loosens at any step from T on, and that only members give to what members require.

edits.where: 4 arrow e2.good | e2.swing (又补回来了 | 来回摆，停不住), zh
edits.old: 回推越过那个点，恰在它超过缺口的时候。按固定步子、读数又来得晚的纠正：恰在带宽容得下延迟期间推出去的量时，才停在带内；否则有的起点会在带的两头之外来回摆，没有止境。
edits.new: 一次推回会不会越过那个点，只看它超不超过缺口。按固定步子推、读数又来得晚的纠正：它守的范围容得下延迟期间推出去的量，从范围下方起步的就都停在范围之内；容不下，就有从范围下方起步的，在范围两头之外来回摆，没有止境。
edits.why: [fix] Terms are right (推回, 范围) and the first iff is kept. The second lost a direction: 容得下……，才停在范围之内 says only 'settles only if'. Regulation.relay_threshold is two-way, and its settling side is 'every start held below the band'; held_oscillates gives 'some start below swings without end'. Said as two plain directions, as path returns step 12 already does. 一次推回会不会越过 replaces 推回越不越过, where 回越 runs together.

edits.where: 5 arrow b2.uncounted → b2.counted (用掉的不在账上 → 代价算进去了), zh
edits.old: 规则若在自己的标准达到之后把原先漏掉的那一样也算上，最好的结果守得住需要，恰在有办法既达标又守住的时候；规则若奖励守住，则在奖励超过守住所放弃的时候。
edits.new: 规则若在自己的标准达到之后，把原先没算进去的那样东西也算上：最好的结果保不保得住对它的需要，只看有没有一种办法既达标又保得住。规则若是奖励保住这份需要：只要奖励超过为保住它而放弃的，最好的结果就保得住。
edits.why: [fix] Structure is right: first half an iff (SetPointOptimum.counted_after_keeps_iff), second half a sufficient condition (Optimum.frontier_keeps_above), and 住所 is gone. Three changes: 原先漏掉的那一样 becomes the shared 没算进去的那样东西; the second half gets 只要 so the condition shows; 守 becomes 保, the word the sibling arrow, its tag and path lock 13 use for keeping a need. 对它的需要 says which need (the Lean's need is on the one condition left out).

edits.where: 6 box c1.same (从这儿看都一样), eg_zh
edits.old: 比如只在油箱见底时才亮的油灯：半箱和快没了，看起来一样。
edits.new: 比如只在油箱见底时才亮的油量警示灯：半箱和快没了，看起来一样。
edits.why: [keep] 油灯 is an oil lamp; 油量警示灯 is the fuel light of the English. Nothing else changes.

edits.where: 7 stay at e2.rest (不再变了), zh
edits.old: 过程一旦到了它的律不再改变的状态，此后每一步都停在那里：律固定时，里面没有什么能再推动它。
edits.new: 过程一旦到了一个它的规律不去改动的状态，此后每一步都停在那里：规律固定时，里面没有什么能再推动它。
edits.why: [fix] 规律 for 律 is right, and the old misreading (the law itself stops changing) is removed. But 不会再去改动 adds 'any more': LoopReturn.stays_from_fixed asks only that the law maps the state to itself, with nothing about earlier steps. 不去改动 is 'leaves as it is'.

edits.where: 8 box b2.felt (及时传到了), says_zh
edits.old: 已经影响到了能左右规则的一方
edits.new: 已经影响到了定规则的各方里至少一方
edits.why: [fix] The first reader is right that 能左右规则 overstates (the next sentence and the arrow to b2.heard deny it). The shared term is 定规则的各方, not 定规则时算数的一方. 'Something whose judgment enters the rule' is one of them at least (ReadOffInTime.FirstApart: some member of the group), and 至少一方 also lets the next sentence's 它们有多少 read.

edits.where: 9 arrow b2.uncounted → a2.supplied (用掉的不在账上 → 够用), zh
edits.old: 要是允许的结果只限于保住每一份需要的那些，其中还能多得，那么按规则最好的结果一份供给也不会断：它取走的，恰好是超出需要的富余。
edits.new: 要是只允许这样的结果：对规则没算进去的那样东西的每一份需要都保得住；这些结果里又还能多得，那么按规则最好的结果，这些需要哪一份都不会断供：它取走的，恰好是超出这些需要的富余。
edits.why: [fix] The restored condition is right: Optimum.keeping_optimum_takes_slack restricts outcomes to those keeping each need on the conditions beyond what the rule counts, not every need whatever. But 靠规则不算的那样东西的每一份需要 reads 靠 as 'by means of', and it uses 不算的 where the shared form is 没算进去的. 这些需要哪一份 keeps the conclusion to those needs; 哪一份需要都不会断供 alone reads as any need at all.

edits.where: 10 box e2.round (转一圈又回来), says_zh, second sentence
edits.old: 路上每个环节收多少就传多少，转着走的东西每一圈都原样回来。
edits.new: 要是路上每个环节收多少就传多少，转着走的东西每一圈都原样回来。
edits.why: [keep] The English has 'Where each link … passes on exactly what it gets', and LoopReturn.loop_kept has it as a premise (every link gives on what it receives). The old stated it as a fact of the box.

edits.where: 11 box a1.over (用得比补得快), says_zh, last sentence
edits.old: 这里用不着什么规则。
edits.new: 有没有规则，都可能这样。
edits.why: [fix] The old did read as advice. But 都可以这样 swaps it for a permission ('either way one may do this'). 可能 says what 'No rule need be involved' says: it can be so with or without a rule.

edits.where: 12 box a1.new (总有新的), says_zh, second sentence
edits.old: 这要来的比去的多，还要原先不变的东西也跟着变。
edits.new: 要这样，来的必须比去的多，原先固定不变的东西也必须不断地变。
edits.why: [fix] 这要来的 was a trap and 跟着变 had lost 'keep'. In the proposal 来的得比去的多 puts 的得 together, and 得 is read as the particle; 必须 is plain. 不断地变 fits HeldPossible.changes_of_heldKeepsWidening (the held part changes again and again without end, not at every moment) better than 一直在变.

edits.where: 13 arrow a1.over → a1.past (用得比补得快 → 回不了头了), zh, second sentence
edits.old: 回不了头的那一点，来的时候靠它延续的还够用。
edits.new: 回不了头的那一点到来的时候，靠它延续的还够用。
edits.why: [keep] Same content, and the comma no longer cuts subject from verb. It now matches path stock step 6 word for word. RegimeMargin.root_above_need: the point of no return lies at or above the need.

edits.where: 14 arrow b0.together → b0.lost (各自不多，合起来超了 → 留着不如拿走), zh
edits.old: 补给这份存量的，自己也靠它延续；其余的光是它们自己，取的就一直比补的多。时间够长，存量就跌到那份需要以下，再也回不来，多出来的那一个取多取少都一样；事后再去看存量，它的取和它的留得分相同。
edits.new: 要是补给这份存量的，自己也靠它延续；撇开某一个不算，光是其余的，取的就已经比补的多，而且这样持续得够久：那么存量就跌到补给它的一方的需要以下，再也回不来，不管撇开的那一个取多取少。事后再去看存量，它取也好、留也好，得分都一样。
edits.why: [fix] The three faults named are real, and 补给它的一方的需要 and 它取也好、留也好 are good. But 其余的不算再添的那一个 reads as 'the rest do not count the added one', and the 'Suppose … Then' frame was still stated as fact. 撇开某一个不算，光是其余的 introduces the one more before it is referred to, and 要是……：那么 is the map's own form for a supposition. Conditions checked against Exclusion.outrun_below: every giver needs the stock, the rest alone take more than is given at each of enough steps, nothing asked of the one set aside.

edits.where: 15 arrow b1.held → b2.counted (自己撑住自己 → 代价算进去了), zh
edits.old: 其余的开始把损耗算进去，规则接连重定两次：规则就此转过去、定在另一边，恰好是在第二次重定时，合起来的判断仍然不利于它原先偏向的一方。是什么让它们开始算，没有定律说。
edits.new: 其余的开始把损耗算进去，规则接连重定两次：规则是不是就此转过去、定在另一边，只看第二次重定时，合起来的判断是不是仍然不利于它原先偏向的一方（打平也算不利）。是什么让它们开始算，没有定律说。
edits.why: [fix] The proposal is right and reads well: 恰好是在第二次重定时 was taken as a time and the iff was lost; 只看 restores both directions, as the sibling arrow b2.felt → b2.counted does. One addition: the condition in ReadInTime.turned_early_iff includes a tie, which the sibling's Chinese states as （打平也算不利）. For an iff that decides which side a tie falls on. Without the parenthesis the text is the first reader's, and stands if the English is left as it is.

edits.where: 16 arrow d0.line → a2.ended (全靠另一个撑着 → 尽了), zh, second sentence
edits.old: 尽顺着每一条这样的链往下传
edits.new: 这个“尽”顺着每一条这样的链往下传
edits.why: [keep] Says what the English says ("The end runs down every such chain"; RegimeMargin Coupled.Indexed.ends_downstream, the positive draw being the first sentence's 每一步又都被取走一些). No condition touched; the quoted “尽” stops the adverb reading of a sentence-initial 尽.

edits.where: 17 box b0.pays (留下的还归自己), says_zh — the first sentence on the page
edits.old: 一个取用的留下多少，日后至少原样归它自己：没有别的先拿走，长得也比“以后”打的折扣快。这时最好的做法里，总有留下一些的。
edits.new: 取用的一方留下多少，日后至少原样归它自己：没有别的先拿走，留下的长得也快过“以后”要打的折扣。这时最好的做法里，总有留下一些的。
edits.why: [fix] The proposal's added 它 (它长得也快过…) points back at 它自己, the taker, so it reads as the taker growing; in the English "it regrows" is what was left (Optimum.frontier_leaves: the level rises faster than the weighting falls). 留下的 in its place. 取用的一方 matches a1.over → a2.else. "Some best move" stays existential (总有留下一些的).

edits.where: 18 box d1.round (有来有往), says_zh
edits.old: 各自都因为所等的给了才给，于是给就这么接下去。中断能过去、不传开，是在这样的地方：所等的里面少了这么几个它也照给，或者中断短过它肯等的步数；要是各自都得所等的上一步全给了才给，中断就往下传。
edits.new: 各自都是所等的给了才给，于是给就这么接下去。要是各自所等的里面中断的那几个，它都少得起，或者中断比它肯等的步数短，中断就过得去、不传开；要是各自都得所等的上一步全给了才给，中断就往下传。
edits.why: [fix] The idea is right; three things changed. (1) 在两种情形下 adds a count the English does not have and can be read as 'in exactly two cases'; the laws are sufficient conditions only (Tolerance.thin_absorbed, WindowedWaiting.gives_unless_errs), so the sentence is now 要是…，中断就过得去, parallel to the closing 要是…，中断就往下传. (2) 它 had no antecedent; 各自 is now stated. (3) 断了几个 becomes 中断 (one word for a lapse), and 少得起 is the word the stay at d1.round already uses for 'can do without'.

edits.where: 19 box d1.gap (有一环没接上), says_zh
edits.old: 至少有一个不给了，别的还在给。这个缺口要么被带过去，要么等着它的跟着不给：顺着一串“等”传下去、到头就出去了，或者在一圈“等”里一直转，或者在中断补不回来的地方，传到顺着“等”够得着的每一个，从此都不给。
edits.new: 至少有一个不给了，别的还在给。这个缺口要么就这么过去了，要么等着它的也跟着不给：顺着一串“等”传下去，传到头就没了；或者在一圈“等”里一直转；或者，要是中断永远补不回来，就传到顺着“等”够得着的每一个，从此都不给。
edits.why: [fix] The proposal carries every branch of the English (passed over; down a line and off its end, gives_without_chain; round a loop for ever, withholding_returns; spread for good where a lapse is never made up, withholding_spreads under waitsAll). One change: 从来补不回 looks backward (从来 is 'never up to now'); the law is that a lapse once made is not made up at any later step, so 永远补不回来.

edits.where: 20 box d3.several (各用各的), says_zh
edits.old: 不止一种做法在用，或者还没有哪一种，还没有都归到同一个上。
edits.new: 在用的做法不止一种，或者一种都还没有；总之还没有都归到同一个上。
edits.why: [keep] Same content as the English (more than one, or none yet; and not all on one). 同一个 matches the neighbouring box 都用同一个. No condition or quantifier changed.

edits.where: 21 box d0.ring (彼此都离不开), says_zh
edits.old: 哪一个做了什么，隔着几层，都够得着其余每一个的延续，也就绕回它自己。取和给一样算：这说的是相连，不是善意。按时间先后看，这种够得着可能到某一步就断了。
edits.new: 哪一个做了什么，隔着几层，都影响得到其余每一个能不能延续，也就绕回它自己。取和给一样算：这说的是相连，不是善意。按时间先后看，这种相连可能到某一步就断了。
edits.why: [keep] 影响得到…能不能延续 is the Lean's own gloss of Flow.MutuallyDependent ("every formation's continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other"); 'can' is kept (得到), 'every other' is kept (其余每一个). 这种相连可能到某一步就断了 keeps "can stop after some step" (Drawing.lapses) and uses the box's own word 相连.

edits.where: 22 arrow d1.gap → d1.round (有一环没接上 → 有来有往), zh
edits.old: 各自都能少等几个、少的不比断掉的少时，下一步全都照给。各自只要所等的都给了就给、而一串串的“等”有个最长的长度时，过了那么多步全都照给。
edits.new: 要是各自所等的里面中断的那几个，它都少得起，下一步就全都照给。要是各自只要所等的都给了就给，而一串串的“等”都短于某个长度，过了那么多步就全都照给。
edits.why: [fix] First sentence: the proposal's meaning is right (Tolerance.thin_absorbed: each waits on at most its tolerance among those that lapsed; then all give from the next step), but 所等的里面断掉几个 has no owner and 这么几个时 is still heavy; rewritten with 各自 as owner, 中断 for the lapse, 少得起 as at the stay of d1.round, and 要是 at the head. Second sentence: 长度有上限时，过了上限那么多步 is off by one if some chain is as long as the bound. Withholding.gives_without_chain: no chain is L waits long, and all give from step L on. 都短于某个长度…过了那么多步 says exactly that and is the wording the giving path already has at step 7.

edits.where: 23 arrow d0.ring | a1.past (彼此都离不开 | 回不了头了), zh
edits.old: 有限多份存量，哪一份剩得多了，各自得到的补给都不会更少，并且都在一个带内：其中一份走到尽，恰好是它起步时低于某个最低水平；别的存量站得越高，这个水平不会更高。
edits.new: 有限几样存量，不管哪一样剩得多些，各自得到的补给都不会因此变少，水平又都不出一个范围：其中哪一样会不会走到尽，只看它起步时是不是低于某个最低水平；别的存量多些，这个最低水平不会更高。
edits.why: [fix] The proposal keeps every condition (finitely many; each renewed no less the more is left of any, Rises; levels within a band, Band; ends iff it starts below the threshold, ends_iff_below; the threshold no higher with the others higher, threshold_falls), and 范围 and ……，只看…… follow the shared words. One change: the separate stocks were counted with 份 (几份存量, 哪一份, 其中一份), which is the word kept for a unit of stock (补进一份). They are now 几样, as a1.up → a1.new already has it (固定的有限几样存量); 其中哪一样 rather than 其中一样, which can be read as 'likewise'.

edits.where: 24 arrow e1.line → e1.ring (只往下传，不回来 → 做出去的又绕回自己), zh, first sentence
edits.old: 一条因果的链子在某一步合成圈，恰在这一步有个起作用的环节，它给出多少，要看它所给之处下游的某个存量。
edits.new: 一条因果的链子是不是在某一步合成环，只看这一步有没有这样一个起作用的环节：它给出多少，要看它给到的地方下游的某个存量。
edits.why: [fix] The proposal restores the if-and-only-if (Closing.onLoop_succ_iff: a loop formed by step T+1 is one formed by T or one through a coupling acting at T that reads a level downstream of what it gives to) and puts 环 for the ring. But in 有没有一个起作用的环节，它给出多少，要看… the defining clause trails off after a comma and reads as an afterthought, so the condition seems to be only 'whether a link acts at this step'. 这样一个…环节： binds the clause to the link.

edits.where: 25 arrow e2.norest → e2.rest (怎么都不算够 → 不再变了), zh
edits.old: 至多比上限多一步就停下
edits.new: 至多走“上限加一”步就停下
edits.why: [keep] Training.comes_to_rest: reward at most B, at rest at step B+1 from every start. The proposal says B+1 steps; the old could be taken as stopping one step past the ceiling. Nothing else changes.

edits.where: 26 stay at d0.ring (彼此都离不开), zh
edits.old: 没有哪条定律说它会一直在。按时间先后看，从某一步起断了，从以后每一步起也都断了；造出来的一对，从第一步起连着，从第二步起就不连了，另一对从每一步起都连着。
edits.new: 没有哪条定律说它会一直在。按时间先后看，一旦从某一步算起不相连了，从以后哪一步算起也都不相连；造出来的一对，从第一步算起相连，从第二步算起就不相连了，另一对从每一步算起都相连。
edits.why: [fix] 算起 is right: the law is about mutual dependence counted from a step (Flow.MutuallyDependentFrom.earlier: from t gives from every earlier t'; so not from a step gives not from any later one). But the proposal, like the old, has no 'once': 从某一步算起已经不相连，从以后…也都不相连 can be read as asserting that it does lapse, which no law says (the same stay says one built pair is tied from every step). 一旦 restores the conditional of "once lapsed from a step". The built pairs are as in Drawing.lapses (from the first step, not from the second) and Recurring.inTime (from every step).

edits.where: 27 stay at d0.line (全靠另一个撑着), zh
edits.old: 每个部分都在它才在的整体，恰好在每个部分都在的时候延续，用不着有什么新生出来。造出来的一条链里，有一环不被取用，它就不会被耗干，靠着它的也就保住了，尽管链头已经尽了。
